Name: FIFA 15 Ultimate Team
Description: EA's card-collecting football mode: build a squad from player cards and take it online.

Achievements.Name: Corner Maestro
Achievements.Description: Score off the post or cross bar in a match.

Achievements.Name: Clean sheet
Achievements.Description: Finish a match without conceding a goal.

Achievements.Name: Fairplay
Achievements.Description: Receive no yellow or red cards during a match.

Achievements.Name: Feather touch
Achievements.Description: Have no fouls awarded against your team in a match.

Achievements.Name: Natural born talent
Achievements.Description: Score a goal with your GK!

Achievements.Name: Attacking Rage
Achievements.Description: Win a game with 10+ shots on goal and 70% shot accuracy.

Achievements.Name: Iron Defense
Achievements.Description: Win a game without conceding a goal and with a 70% successful tackling rate.

Achievements.Name: First Step
Achievements.Description: Win your first match.

Achievements.Name: Aerial Threat
Achievements.Description: Score with a header after a cross.

Achievements.Name: One-Two Master
Achievements.Description: Score a goal after successfully pulling an one-two move.

Achievements.Name: Give It Your All
Achievements.Description: Score with an injured player.

Achievements.Name: Hat Trick
Achievements.Description: Score 3 goals in a match - with the same player.

Achievements.Name: A Handful Of Goals
Achievements.Description: Score 5 goals in a match - with the same player.

Achievements.Name: Defence Is the Best Attack
Achievements.Description: Win a game while scoring only with defenders.

Achievements.Name: A Job Well Done
Achievements.Description: Win by scoring with all your starting line-up attackers.

Achievements.Name: Inspiration
Achievements.Description: Score with a subbed-in player.

Achievements.Name: Long Range
Achievements.Description: Score with a shot more than 30m away.

Achievements.Name: One on One
Achievements.Description: Score after going 1 on 1 with the goalkeeper.

Achievements.Name: Last Man Standing
Achievements.Description: Get possession after performing a sliding tackle as a last defender.

Achievements.Name: Woodwork & In!
Achievements.Description: Score off the post or cross bar in a match.
